title: How do administrators search surveys?
intent: This article explains how administrators search and manage all surveys system-wide.
short_answer: Administrators can search all surveys in the system from Administration > Surveys. This includes published, unpublished, deleted, archived, frozen, and reported surveys. Administrators can perform actions like freeze, restore, delete permanently, and change ownership.
procedure: Use the search form to filter surveys by title, shortname, owner, status, dates, etc.
View survey details in the results table.
Perform administrative actions: freeze, unfreeze, restore deleted, permanently delete, change owner, export.
important_conditions: Administrators can see all surveys regardless of ownership.
Surveys can be filtered by multiple criteria: title, UID, owner, dates, status, language, type.
Different tabs show: all surveys, deleted, archived, frozen, reported.
Administrators can export survey statistics in XLSX or DOCX format.
Administrators can permanently delete soft-deleted surveys.
troubleshooting: No surveys found: Adjust search criteria or check that the survey exists.
